results.title: Saýara
results.overview: When her sister is murdered by a group of politically connected rich kids, Sayara, a quiet gym cleaner from Turkmenistan, begins to follow in her father's footsteps, seeking a path of revenge.

results.title: The Cowboy
results.overview: The arrival of a stray horse triggers a series of events in Bernicia’s life that alters her world as she slowly takes on the persona of a cowboy. Through her journey, she must overcome several obstacles that threaten her newfound desires.

results.title: Dolphin Boy
results.overview: While wallowing at the beach, DB finds a girl washed up on the shore.

results.title: Après Anna
results.overview: One evening, the doorbell rings at Adrien's house. It's Victor, whom he hasn't seen in years: his sister, Anna, has disappeared. They set out to find her in the streets of the Paris suburbs. But as the two friends worry about Anna, they come face to face with their own frailties.

results.title: Selling a Colonial War
results.overview: In the Netherlands, colonial history is slowly but surely being rewritten. It has long been clear  that what the Dutch government at the time described as “police actions”—the deployment of the army in response to Indonesia’s declaration of independence in 1945—was in fact an unlawful war. Nonetheless, the use of the term “war crimes” is still sensitive.  This documentary reveals how far the Dutch rulers went in selling the war as a domestic affair, intended to restore peace among the population. Unique, often shocking images tell a different story. Filmmaker In-Soo Radstake holds extensive interviews with international experts who explain the complex relationships in the former colony and set out the global context.

results.title: Trato Humano
results.overview: An elderly woman accustomed to human interaction verbalizes what she needs to be heard.

results.title: MARO - Hortelã
results.overview: Making of "hortelã", MARO's latest acoustic album.

results.title: Physical Brightness Contest
results.overview: The ultimate strength contest to determine the king of stamina! Who will be the last one standing in this epic showdown, where three male contenders, boasting an overwhelming length nearing 30 centimeters, immeasurable girth, and jaw-dropping techniques that will have you sticking your tongue out, face off against a trio of sexy opponents armed with vacuum-like suction, fiery heat that could melt steel, and a tight grip filled with slippery slickness? Who will survive the greatest sexual showdown on earth and emerge as the ultimate champion in this battle of physical prowess?

results.title: Lula
results.overview: An intimate and revelatory portrait of one of the world’s most influential political figures, Lula explores the rise, fall and triumphant return of beloved Brazilian leader Luiz Inácio “Lula” da Silva, chronicling his extraordinary journey in 2022 to regain the Brazilian presidency after spending nineteen months in prison.

results.title: Bones
results.overview: After the discovery of some human bones at a site, Adela and Javier, a couple of archaeologists with years of experience, have to live with the first signs of Javier's dementia and a new discovery, which like an echo, seems to resonate more and more in their daily life.

results.title: John Cranko
results.overview: The gifted, charismatic artist John Cranko moves to the Swabian province from London, where he is attacked for his homosexuality, and after many crises becomes the great sensation as the new pop star of the arts: the Stuttgart Ballet Miracle.

results.title: Lucky Strikes
results.overview: A washed-up Indigenous bowler and his best friend competing in a national bowling championship in an attempt to raise money to preserve one's father's legacy and save their local bowling lanes from the wrecking ball.

results.title: Extra Festive
results.overview: A middle-aged gay couple resign themselves to a cheap motel in the midst of Manila's Christmas nighttime rush. Later, a lost present is found in the hands of a younger, mysterious stranger.

results.title: Luna Azul
results.overview: Two Venezuelans, Laura a catholic novice nun, and her Ex-Fiancé Carlos meet again, in order to resolve the traumatic past that separated them.

results.title: La Tamalera
results.overview: Ada is a hardworking mother struggling to make ends meet in a neighborhood marked by violence and uncertainty. Through her small tamale business, she supports her family and fights to maintain a sense of dignity and stability.  When local criminals begin to threaten her livelihood and the safety of her community, Ada is forced to confront a reality she can no longer avoid. What begins as intimidation quickly escalates, pushing her to make difficult and dangerous decisions.  Driven by love for her children and a fierce determination to protect what she has built, Ada rises against powerful enemies, proving that true strength does not come from power, but from courage and resilience.  In a world where hope is fragile, one mother’s fight becomes a symbol of resistance and survival.

results.title: Laid Bare
results.overview: A struggling painter finds glimpses of success when he begins slicing off his own skin and using it for his work.

results.title: Adam Bol
results.overview: Three reckless Kazakhstani men on a trip to America experience an emergency landing in Nigeria, which sets off series of misadventures that test their life ideals, leading to profound personal lessons.

results.title: Planetagatik
results.overview: Mario, a scientist conducting experiments at an advanced food research center with his colleague Karla, turns to his boss Juana when new environmental policies for employees become unbearable.

results.title: Tem Gente Que Fica
results.overview: Four friends gather for dinner, but the absence of a fifth lingers in the room. While Maya longs to return to the past, the evening reveals that everything — the friends, the town, and even herself — has irrevocably changed.

results.title: You Can't Run Forever
results.overview: A teenage girl suffering from anxiety due to a tragic event from her past finds herself hunted through the woods by a sociopath on a murderous rampage.
